grammar_archive.topic: Linking adverbials - sabab, natija, qo'shimcha va qarama-qarshilik (therefore, however, moreover, consequently)

parts.1: 📌 Linking Adverbials: Fikrlarni bog'lash san'ati (1/5-qism) Ingliz tilida gaplarni bir-biriga mantiqan bog'lash va fikrni ravon yetkazish uchun linking adverbials (bog'lovchi ravishlar) qo'llaniladi. Ular yozma va og'zaki nutqda sabab, natija, qo'shimcha fikr hamda qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatish uchun xizmat qiladi. Therefore, however, moreover va consequently kabi so'zlar nutqimizni yanada boyitadi va fikrni akademik darajada ifodalashga yordam beradi. Ushbu bog'lovchilar yordamida murakkab va mantiqli jumlalar tuzish ancha osonlashadi. 📖 Oddiy misollar: • She studied hard; therefore, she passed the exam easily. (U qattiq o'qidi; shuning uchun u imtihondan oson o'tdi.) • The weather was cold; however, we went for a walk. (Havo sovuq edi; shunga qaramay, biz sayrga chiqdik.) 💡 Eslatma: Ushbu seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida sabab, natija, qo'shimcha fikr va qarama-qarshilik bog'lovchilarining gapdagi o'rni, darak hamda inkor holatlardagi tuzilishi va tinish belgilari qo'llanilishini alohida ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanallimizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Grammar Time: Linking Adverbials (2/5) 📖 Bugun fikrlarni mantiqan bog'laydigan linking adverbials (bog'lovchi ravishlar) ning darak gaplardagi qo'llanish tartibini o'rganamiz. ⚡ Darak gap tuzilishi: 1-mustaqil gap + . / ; + Linking Adverbial + , + 2-mustaqil gap 📝 Misollar: 🔹 However (qarama-qarshilik): The weather was terrible; however, we decided to go hiking. (Ob-havo juda yomon edi; shunday bo'lsa-da, biz sayrga chiqishga qaror qildik.) 🔹 Therefore (natija): She studied hard for the exam. Therefore, she got the highest mark. (U imtihonga qunt bilan tayyorlandi. Shuning uchun, u eng yuqori ball oldi.) 🔹 Moreover (qo'shimcha): The new laptop is lightweight. Moreover, it has a long battery life. (Yangi noutbuk juda yengil. Buning ustiga, uning batareyasi uzoqqa yetadi.) 🔹 Consequently (sabab-natija): He missed the last train. Consequently, he had to take a taxi. (U oxirgi poyezdga kechikdi. Natijada, u taksi tutishga majbur bo'ldi.) 💡 Muhim eslatma: Ushbu bog'lovchi ravishlardan so'ng har doim vergul (,) ishlatiladi. Ularni oddiy bog'lovchilar (but, and, so) kabi nuqtasiz yoki nuqtali vergulsiz to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gap o'rtasiga qo'yib bo'lmaydi.
parts.3: 📌 Linking Adverbials: Inkor gaplarda qo'llanishi (3/5-qism) 💡 Bog'lovchi ravishlar (therefore, however, moreover, consequently) inkor gaplar bilan kelganda, sodir bo'lmagan hodisalar yoki salbiy natijalarni bog'lash uchun xizmat qiladi. ✅ Inkor gap formulasi: 1-gap + [Linking Adverbial] + Subject + auxiliary verb + not + Verb 📖 Misollar: 1. He studied very hard; however, he didn't pass the final exam. (U juda qattiq tayyorlandi; biroq, yakuniy imtihondan o'ta olmadi.) 2. The weather was awful; therefore, we could not start our journey. (Ob-havo juda yomon edi; shu sababli, biz safarimizni boshlay olmadik.) 3. The company lost money; consequently, they did not hire new staff. (Kompaniya zarar ko'rdi; natijada, ular yangi xodimlarni ishga olishmadi.) 4. The car is too old; moreover, it doesn't run smoothly. (Mashina juda eski; qolaversa, u yaxshi yurmaydi.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Bog'lovchi ravishdan so'ng kelgan inkor gapda yordamchi fe'lni tushirib qoldirmang (masalan, "however he not came" emas, "however, he didn't come" bo'ladi). Shuningdek, however yoki therefore kabi so mezonli ravishlardan keyin har doim vergul (,) qo'yilishini unutmang.
parts.4: 📖 Linking Adverbials: So'roq gaplarda qo'llanishi (4/5) 📌 Linking Adverbials (therefore, however, moreover, consequently) ko'pincha oldingi fikrga bog'langan holda mantiqiy savol berish uchun ishlatiladi. 💡 Umumiy so'roq gap (Yes/No questions) formulasi: [Darak gap]; Linking Adverbial + Yordamchi fe'l + Ega + Asosiy fe'l ...? 💡 Maxsus so'roq gap (Wh- questions) formulasi: [Darak gap]; Linking Adverbial + Wh-so'z + Yordamchi fe'l + Ega + Fe'l ...? 📝 Misol jumlalar: 🔹 The weather was terrible; however, did you enjoy your trip? (Ob-havo juda yomon edi; shunga qaramay, sayohatingizdan rohatlandingizmi?) 🔹 The sales decreased this month; therefore, should we change our strategy? (Bu oy sotuvlar kamaydi; shu sababli, strategiyamizni o'zgartirishimiz kerakmi?) 🔹 The product is very expensive; moreover, why is its quality so poor? (Mahsulot juda qimmat; ustiga-akasi, nega uning sifati bunchalik yomon?) 🔹 He missed the final deadline; consequently, what will happen to his project? (U yakuniy muddatni o'tkazib yubordi; natijada, uning loyihasi nima bo'ladi?) ❗ Eslatma: Yozma nutqda ushbu bog'lovchi so me'yorida ikki gap o'rtasida nuqtali vergul (;) va o'zidan keyin vergul (,) bilan ajratib yoziladi.

grammar_archive.topic: Present Perfect Continuous (hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakatning davomiyligini ta'kidlash)

parts.1: 🇬🇧 Present Perfect Continuous zamoni bilan tanishamiz! (1/5-qism) 📌 Ushbu zamon o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgi paytgacha to'xtovsiz davom etayotgan harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu yerda asosiy e'tibor harakatning yakunlanganiga emas, balki uning qancha vaqt davom etganiga qaratiladi. Agar siz biror ishni qanchadan beri qilayotganingizni alohida ta'kidlamoqchi bo'lsangiz, aynan shu grammatik zamondan foydalanasiz. O'zbek tiliga bu zamon ko'pincha "...dan beri qilmoqdaman" yoki "... buyon bajarayapman" shaklida tarjima qilinadi. 📖 Misollar: 🗣️ I have been studying English for three years. (Men uch yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganmoqdaman.) 🗣️ She has been reading this book since morning. (U ertalabdan beri ushbu kitobni o'qiyapti.) 📝 Seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida ushbu zamonning darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishlarini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Bizni kuzatishda davom eting!
